name: Citadel
role: main base, resource drop-off, win/lose objective
description: Each player starts with one Citadel (not buildable). Workers deposit gathered wood, food and gold here. If it is destroyed its owner loses the match immediately.

name: House
description: Raises the population cap by 5, up to the age hard cap (40 in Age I, 60 in Age II). Cheap and fragile.

name: Barracks
description: Trains Spearman in Age I; Guardian and Ram require Age II. Required for the Iron Age research and hosts the Age II melee upgrades.

name: ArcheryYard
description: Trains Archers and researches Longbow Training. Building it (or a Stable) satisfies one prerequisite of the Iron Age.

name: Stable
description: Trains fast Raiders. Costs gold to build, so it competes with early Age research. Building it (or an Archery Yard) satisfies one prerequisite of the Iron Age.
